profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with a master degree in Information Systems, strong leadership, and research skills. Over 10 years software development experience with emphasis on  .NET backend technologies, as well as frontend successful projects.

My other skills include fast self-taught learning, goal achievement focus, teamwork, self-motivation.  Interest in various technologies outside my expertise.

Specialties:  Agile Development (Scrum), Test Driven Development, .NET Frameworks.

projects.title: First Electronic Agent in Costa Rica
projects.description: As part of my graduation project and sponsored by the Costa Rica Central Bank, we set the foundations of Digital Certificates emission to non-physical persons (i.e. Corporations) to give them the power of digital signature. The project included proposals on how to create synergy between several public entities in the country (such as The National Registry, Ministry of Labour, Central Bank, Ministry of Treasury and Ministry of Technology) with detailed technical data models on how to exchange the information between them. The project is expected to be released on 2013.
